critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: email attach menu uses CSS group-hover only (no click/keyboard alternative). Playwright can drive it via hover-then-click, but keyboard/mobile users cannot reach files. Consider toggling the menu on click as well as hover (a11y + touch).

Non-blocking observability: grade_email_ai() fail-opens (credits all AI tasks with rating='Unrated') when Claude errors. Consider surfacing an admin log/metric so silent Claude outages are still visible to Guides.

Non-blocking (repeat from earlier iterations): backend has grown to ~800 lines and skillstudio.py to ~1330 lines. Splitting per-track (docs/sheets/slides/email) into separate modules would improve maintainability.
